lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [excited] [high voice] I just found a wallet... with a HUNDRED dollars inside!
lines.caption: I just found a wallet with a HUNDRED dollars inside!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [mischievously] [high voice] Keep it! Nobody saw us.
lines.caption: Keep it! Nobody saw us

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [excited] [high voice] We could buy ALL the candy in the world!
lines.caption: We could buy ALL the candy in the world!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [nervous] [high voice] But look... it belongs to Mister Pickle.
lines.caption: But look it belongs to Mister Pickle

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [sighs] [high voice] Ugh, FINE. But I want a reward.
lines.caption: Ugh FINE But I want a reward

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [elderly voice] [surprised] My wallet! I looked EVERYWHERE for it!
lines.caption: My wallet! I looked EVERYWHERE for it!

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [elderly voice] [warmly] You honest kids deserve a reward.
lines.caption: You honest kids deserve a reward

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [whispers] [excited] [high voice] Here it comes... we're gonna be RICH!
lines.caption: Here it comes we're gonna be RICH!

lines.speaker: dottie
lines.tts: [shouting] [high voice] A PICKLE?! We gave back a hundred dollars... for a PICKLE?!
lines.caption: A PICKLE?! We gave back a hundred dollars for a PICKLE?!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [warmly] [high voice] It's okay. We did the right thing.
lines.caption: It's okay We did the right thing

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [curious] [high voice] Wait... Mister Pickle owns the CANDY shop?
lines.caption: Wait Mister Pickle owns the CANDY shop?

lines.speaker: pickle
lines.tts: [elderly voice] [happy] Honest kids eat free. FOREVER! [chuckles]
lines.caption: Honest kids eat free FOREVER!

lines.speaker: bean
lines.tts: [whispers] [high voice] She still thinks it was HER idea.
lines.caption: She still thinks it was HER idea
